analysis.detail: deepmerge (prototype poisoning in mergeObject) is only a build-time dependency of the frontend: it comes in through @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte and through @rollup/plugin-node-resolve, a dependency of flowbite-datepicker. Both are build tools that merge configuration we write; no user or network input reaches them. The production UI bundle contains no deepmerge code (checked on a fresh build on 2026-11-07), flowbite-datepicker's runtime code doesn't import it, and the images ship no Node.js. It appears only in the source SBOM, which lists the frontend's build dependencies.
